actions.text: Refresh resets to page 1 and refetches history.
Options opens a table options modal to change columns and page size.
Selecting a filter in the filter menu sets the selected history filter; a filter modal supports custom filters of type history.
Clicking a column header sorts the table.
The Details button on a row opens a modal with event details and a Close button.
For grabbed events the details modal has a Mark as failed button that posts to the history failed endpoint.

rules.text: History is requested from /history with page, page size, sort key, sort direction and the selected filters; total pages is at least 1.
Episodes for the listed records are fetched by their unique episode ids, and only when there is at least one id.
The current page defaults to 1 and resets to 1 on back/forward navigation; changing page size returns to page 1.
If the selected filter key is empty, no filters are applied; an unmatched key logs an error and applies none.
Mark as failed appears only for grabbed events.
If marking as failed fails, the error 'Error marking history item as failed' is set.

shows.text: The page is titled History, with the heading scope Activity and title History.
A loading indicator shows while history or episodes are loading and the page is not yet fully populated.
If history or episodes fail to load (and nothing is fetching), a danger alert shows the HistoryLoadError message.
When history has loaded without error and has no records, the page shows the NoHistoryFound message.
When populated, without error and with records, a table of history rows is shown with a pager (page, total pages, total records).
The toolbar has Refresh and Options buttons and a filter menu with built-in and custom history filters; the Refresh icon spins while fetching.

Each row can show columns: event type icon (with tooltip), series, episode number, episode title, languages, quality, custom formats, date, download client, indexer, custom format score, release group, source title, and a details button. Only visible columns are rendered.
A row is not rendered until both its series and episode are available.

Event type icons: grabbed and downloadFailed use a downloading icon, seriesFolderImported a drive, downloadFolderImported a downloaded icon, episodeFileDeleted a missing-file icon when the reason is MissingFromDisk otherwise delete, renamed an organize icon, ignored an ignore icon, others unknown. downloadFailed is shown in danger color.
The event type cell tooltip text depends on the event type; grabbed mentions the indexer and download client.
The custom format score cell shows +N, -N, '+0' (when there are custom formats and score is zero), or blank, with a tooltip listing the custom formats.
The download client column shows the download client name, falling back to the download client, else blank. Indexer and release group show blank when absent from the event data.
The details modal title depends on event type: Grabbed, DownloadFailed, EpisodeImported, EpisodeFileDeleted, EpisodeFileRenamed, DownloadIgnored, otherwise Unknown.

For grabbed events the details show Name, Indexer, Release Group, Custom Format Score (if non-zero), Series Match Type, Release Source, Info URL link, Download Client, Grab Id, Age When Grabbed, Published Date and Size, each only when present.
For downloadFailed events the details show Name, Grab Id, Indexer, Message and Source; for downloadIgnored they show Name, Grab Id and Message.
For imported events the details show Name, Source (dropped path), Imported To, Custom Format Score (if non-zero) and File Size.
For deleted file events the details show Name, Reason (Manual, missing from disk, or upgrade), Custom Format Score (if non-zero) and File Size.
For renamed file events the details show source path, source relative path, destination path and destination relative path; other event types show only Name.

sideEffects.text: Marking a history item as failed sends POST /history/failed/{id} and, on success, invalidates the cached history queries.
The page registers a populator that refetches history, and unregisters it when leaving.
